description: The file defines a Web API controller named UserController responsible for user-related operations, such as retrieving current user details and updating user information. It utilizes dependency injection for IMediator and ICurrentUserAccessor, and implements endpoints with ASP.NET Core attributes.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller managing user-related HTTP endpoints for getting current user info and updating user data, secured with JWT authorization.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current user details by username.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update user information with provided command data.
